title: Lower bound for bounded decoding value
statement: Let $G$ be a regular unique game with $q$ labels, let $0<\varepsilon\le 1$, and choose a table of functions on the Boolean cube, each bounded between $-1$ and $1$, a default label, and a vertex. If at least one coordinate has stable influence greater than $\varepsilon$ in the neighbor-averaged, constraint-permuted function at that vertex, then the bounded decoding value at the vertex is at least $\varepsilon^5/18$.
